title: Something Went Wrong
label: ch:ja-something-went-wrong
canDo: I can say what went wrong on a trip (saifu o nakushimashita; kasa ga kowaremashita; densha ni noriokuremashita), ask for help (tasukete kudasai), and say all over Japan (nihonjū).

payoff.summary: Complete JA-R257-something-went-wrong: report a lost wallet, a missed train and a broken umbrella, and ask for help.
